Theorem
[Margulis lemma, algebraic form] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0208 1. ch31:31.36\group Margulis lemma

For every $n$ there is $\varepsilon _n>0$ such that $\{ \gamma :d(\gamma x,x)\le \varepsilon _n\} $ is virtually nilpotent, with index bounded in terms of $n$ only.
